artists.source_line: Kudzi & Maddy (AUSTRALIA) Sydney Battle Kiz Finalists 2025

features.rationale: The description lists the dance classes that make up the 15 hours of lessons and workshops.
The English text advertises stunning shows as part of the event.
An after party on Monday 12 January is announced.
The event has themed nights such as Island Vibes, Oceanic Gala and Denim Fever.

features.quote: Dress code : tenues tropicales et colorées
features.rationale: A dress code is stated for the Friday party.

features.quote: Code promo spécial : KIZ15 pour vos réservations
features.rationale: A special promo code gives a negotiated hotel rate for the recommended Ramada Hôtel without accommodation being part of the pass.
The event venue is the Ramada Hôtel, which is also the listed accommodation, so the parties take place where dancers stay.
